Ethan —

Thanks for the summary. Looping in our procurement lead Rajesh (cc) — he handles vendor setups. A few notes from our side: 

- Aurora generally requires a PO for any contract value above $5,000. For small pilots we can process on card but prefer PO for production usage.
- Please provide a completed vendor setup packet including: company legal name, EIN, remit address, W-9 (if US) or W-8 (if foreign), banking details for ACH, and vendor contact.
- We also require proof of insurance (liability) and a brief vendor questionnaire — I attached our standard PO checklist to this reply.
- Marketplace: yes, if Redwood is available via the cloud marketplace that can speed things up, but we can start the vendor setup in parallel.
- Timeline: once we have a complete packet, vendor approval typically takes 10–15 business days.

Rajesh — any additional items for Redwood to include?

Best,
